name: dot1dTpHCPortTable
description: A table that contains information about every high- capacity port that is associated with this transparent bridge.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.4.4.1.1.name: dot1dTpPort
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.4.4.1.1.description: The port number of the port for which this entry contains Transparent bridging management information.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.4.5.1.1.name: dot1dTpHCPortInFrames
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.4.5.1.1.description: The number of frames that have been received by this port from its segment. Note that a frame received on the interface corresponding to this port is only counted by this object if and only if it is for a protocol being processed by the local bridging function, including bridge management frames.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.4.5.1.2.name: dot1dTpHCPortOutFrames
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.4.5.1.2.description: The number of frames that have been transmitted by this port to its segment. Note that a frame transmitted on the interface corresponding to this port is only counted by this object if and only if it is for a protocol being processed by the local bridging function, including bridge management frames.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.4.5.1.3.name: dot1dTpHCPortInDiscards
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.4.5.1.3.description: Count of valid frames that have been received by this port from its segment that were discarded (i.e., filtered) by the Forwarding Process.
